payload.text: Found 2 gene records and 5 disease records for MLH1, MSH2 and colorectal cancer [2][3][4][5][6][7][8].

The MLH1 protein heterodimerizes with PMS2 to form MutL alpha, a core component of the DNA mismatch repair system that introduces single-strand breaks near DNA mismatches to initiate exonuclease degradation [1].
MLH1 was identified as a locus frequently mutated in hereditary nonpolyposis colon cancer [1].
